_comment: RQ3 at 0.3 m against the dark grey board, two angles only: 0 and 2.5 degrees per side (dtheta 0 and 5). 0 uses the inner arm hole, 2.5 uses the outer hole, so the pin moves once. This is the control arm of the divider test: nothing between the pucks. Pair it with rq3_0p3m_divider.json, which repeats the same two angles with a black strip standing between the pucks. 2026-09-29.
name: rq3-0p3m-no-divider
